Market today: Mixed signals. AI/tech sentiment is strong, boosted by SpaceX's surge and its ripple effect across the "AI universe." However, rising French bond yields to 5% could pressure growth stocks, especially on margin.

Your holdings: Several positions need immediate attention. SOXL (-56.6%), MUU (-32.11%), and SPAL (-36.26%) are leveraged ETFs with stops significantly breached, amplifying deep losses. SMCI (-26%) also has a breached stop. SMH (-14.15%) is on TRIM status and near its stop. Remember, margin amplifies drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields for any further upward movement, which could hurt your tech names. Also, monitor the broader AI sector for continued momentum from catalysts like SpaceX.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions; don't let breached stops linger on margin.
plays: Immediately re-evaluate SOXL (-56.6%), MUU (-32.11%), and SPAL (-36.26%). Their stops are significantly breached, and these leveraged positions on margin demand urgent attention.
Address SMCI (-26%) as its stop at 37.3 is also breached. Consider trimming SMH (-14.15%) if it drops below its 540 stop.
